scenario: LCDB.3.3.4 positive control for LCDB.3.3.4_ttl_needs_by, same schema and rule: `by: h.entity_id` declares the activation key, so the rate modifier over a ttl fact compiles. Pins that the refusal is the omission and not the ttl binding.
rules_ds:
schema Hot scope ttl 5_min:
    entity_id: String
    celsius: Float
    ts: Time

rule alert cooldown 5_min by: h.entity_id:
    Hot h
->
    log critical "overheating: {h.entity_id}"
